scope: Narrow computation/projection amendment, not algorithm/cost acceptance. Interpret the frozen v1 package with only this explicit additional field projection and its three existing-procedure bodies.

base.preservation: All original v1 files and their seal stay byte-identical; their projection defect is preserved as history. Unmentioned interfaces,body identities,fields,fees,input conventions and remaining proof obligations are inherited.

effective_recovery_schemas.Built: value:GTree only; unbox to the actual GTree
effective_recovery_schemas.InitialMeasured: value:Option(Nat*GTree) only; unbox to the actual option
effective_recovery_schemas.Group: origin,labels,color retained; leaf color is the actual color(x).value
effective_recovery_schemas.effect: Only the two exact coloring fields and their work-only dependency arithmetic/loads/constructor slots are newly omitted. No global color/coloring rule.

existing_procedure_interpretations.RWInitial.meterBuild: Evaluate the same color callback once per reached leaf,retain its actual value,build the same groups/trees and paths in left-before-right order; no omitted .work or .coloring read.
existing_procedure_interpretations.RWInitial.meterInitial: Retain first Leaves/Nodup,second Leaves/length,real build and capped budget; return the same actual Option pair; omit the dead coloring diagnostic.
existing_procedure_interpretations.RWInitial.meterGenerate: Same init.value case and same real meterRun invocation or retained malformed Receipt; no init.coloring consumer exists.

source_identity.use: Existing frozen computation/type views only; no new source body,proof value,peer outcome or transitive grant.

control_constants.source: frozen v1 literal text bound, transferred by deletion only

remaining: Whole canonical value/source-occurrence coupling,actual local/global cost/width/space proof and independent whole acceptance remain open. Use the v2 projection for later counting/source interfaces; no actual v1 run/cost theorem is asserted.
